name: Postman MCP Generator
description: An MCP server that converts Postman API requests into executable tools for LLMs using the Postman Runtime. It supports complex authentication types and enables seamless integration between Postman collections and MCP clients like Claude Desktop.

SSE.description: Enable Server-Sent Events (SSE) support to launch the server with the /sse and /messages endpoints enabled (equivalent to --sse flag).

ACME_API_KEY.description: Example API key for a workspace (environment variable key generated based on workspace slug).

STREAMABLE_HTTP.description: Enable Streamable HTTP support to launch the server with the /mcp endpoint enabled (equivalent to --streamable-http flag).
